hypothesis: Start the next native lineage with the simplest Enyo-native feature set: 1 input bucket, 12 piece-square channels, 1024 hidden, 1 output bucket. This tests whether removing king buckets avoids data starvation on the current 10M-row dataset before reintroducing 2/4/8/16 bucket layouts by Elo.

changed_variables.architecture: 1x12 input layout instead of 16x12; 1024 hidden to match Enyo runtime

stages.name: train
stages.command: ENYO_BULLET_MODE=enyo ENYO_BULLET_DATA=data/bullet/lc0q10m.bullet ENYO_BULLET_OUT=runs/native-9.0.0-rc1/checkpoints ENYO_BULLET_SUPERBATCHES=760 ENYO_BULLET_LR=1e-3 ENYO_BULLET_FINAL_LR=1e-4 ENYO_BULLET_HIDDEN=1024 ENYO_BULLET_L2=16 ENYO_BULLET_ENYO_OUTPUT_BUCKETS=1 ENYO_BULLET_ENYO_INPUT_BUCKETS=1 ENYO_BULLET_ENYO_FEATURE_CHANNELS=12 ENYO_BULLET_THREADS=8 ENYO_BULLET_WDL=0.3 ENYO_BULLET_EXPORT_INIT_ONLY=0 tools/bullet/spike_trainer/target/release/enyo-bullet-spike
stages.why: Train the simplest Enyo native net first: 768 features per perspective, no king buckets, runtime-compatible 1024 hidden, and otherwise the same data/dose/lr family.

stages.name: export_and_copy
stages.command: src=runs/native-9.0.0-rc1/checkpoints/enyo_bullet_spike-760/quantised.bin; dst=$HOME/assets/nets/native-9.0.0-rc1.nn; expected_size=1610052; ls -lh "$src"; actual=$(stat -c '%s' "$src"); if [ "$actual" -lt "$expected_size" ]; then echo "ERROR: $src is $actual bytes, expected at least $expected_size" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected_size" ]; then echo "Trimming Bullet padding: $actual -> $expected_size bytes"; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/assets/nets"; head -c "$expected_size" "$src" > "$dst"; stat -c '%n %s bytes' "$dst"
stages.why: Copy final checkpoint to assets as the candidate net.

stages.name: smoke_test
stages.command:
printf 'uci
isready
setoption name nnue_file value ~/assets/nets/native-9.0.0-rc1.nn
position fen r1bqkb1r/pppp1ppp/2n2n2/4p3/2B1P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQK2R w KQkq - 4 4
go depth 1
quit
' | ~/assets/engines/enyo_91ede5f
stages.why: The engine must be built from the Enyo branch with 1-bucket runtime support. Startup must log evaluator=native-nnue, the candidate path, sha256, hidden=1024, input_buckets=1, feature_channels=12.

stages.name: sprt_256_game_smoke
stages.why: 256-game smoke vs default.net before any longer SPRT. Gate: neutral-positive, or reject and iterate.

stages.name: sprt_1k_main
stages.why: Only run if the 256-game smoke is not negative. Elo, not training loss, decides whether this simple architecture is worth keeping.

gates: Enyo engine build with 1-bucket support passes unit tests and accumulator refresh tests
smoke_test logs evaluator=native-nnue with hidden=1024 input_buckets=1 feature_channels=12 and the expected sha256
256-game smoke is neutral-positive before any longer SPRT
if accepted, try 2 buckets next; if rejected, tune only one of init scale, lr, or data dose
notes: This follows Bullet's recommendation to start with a simple net before scaling architecture.
Do not warm-start from 16-bucket weights into this 1-bucket layout without an explicit folding converter.
Keep WDL/lr/data unchanged for this first architecture test; mutate one of those only after this baseline is measured.
The required engine is not the old enyo_dcc637b binary; it must include the Enyo 1-bucket loader/runtime changes.
